changelog:
Trustpilot-company-info v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides Trustpilot company profile lookup by domain, extracting detailed metadata including TrustScore, star rating, review counts, categories, verification flags, status, website/contact info, and optional reply behavior metrics.
- Accurately detects when a company profile is not found and returns isCompanyFound=false with the searched domain.
- Designed for single or bulk domain enrichment (lead-list enrichment, supplier/agency vetting, brand monitoring, due diligence).
- No login required; operates within public web access boundaries via browser automation using server-rendered JSON.
- Supports advanced filtering and bulk data extraction use cases with clear error handling and retriable workflow guidance.
summary: Trustpilot company profile lookup on trustpilot.com — input a company domain (e.g. apple.com, shopify.com, shopwagandtail.com) and extract company metadata: official display name, businessUnitId, TrustScore (1-5), star rating, total review count, last-12-months review count, primary category and all
